title: Archival Preservation of Cell Suspensions for scRNA-Seq
author: Linas Mazutis

steps.title: Dissociate tissue to single cells
steps.instruction: Using a tissue dissociation method of your choice, dissociate the solid tissue sample into a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Resuspend cells with FBS and DAPI
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dissociated cells in 400 µL cell culture medium (e.g., RPMI or DMEM) supplemented with 2.5 % FBS and 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ DAPI. Adjust the concentration to 500–2000 cells µL⁻¹ and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add preservation media and FACS‑sort
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Bambanker preservation media to a 15 mL FACS collection tube. FACS‑sort DAPI‑negative (live) cells directly into the preservation media, collecting >200 000 cells ideally (minimum 50 000). Keep dilution of the preservation medium by the FACS buffer below 50 %.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend to target density
steps.instruction: Transfer the sorted suspension to 1.5 mL Lo‑Protein‑Bind tubes (≤500 µL per tube; split into two tubes of ~400 µL each if volume exceeds 0.5 mL). Place the 1.5 mL tubes inside a 50 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge in a swinging‑bucket rotor at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes. After spin, carefully remove the supernatant leaving ~20 µL in the tube, then add preservation medium to bring the cell concentration to 1000–2000 cells µL⁻¹. Gently resuspend with a 1000 µL or 200 µL pipette, avoiding bubbles, clumps, and leaving a final volume of ~50–100 µL.

steps.title: Slow‑freeze cells for storage
steps.instruction: Freeze the cells at –1 °C min⁻¹ by placing the tube in an isopropanol‑filled container and storing it at –80 °C. The next day transfer the tube to a liquid‑nitrogen tank for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Rapidly thaw frozen cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the scRNA‑seq platform and reagents in advance. Remove the tube from liquid nitrogen, place it in a 37 °C water bath, and incubate for 1–2 minutes (total thaw time 5–10 minutes). Process the cells within 15 minutes to avoid quality loss.

steps.title: Count thawed cells
steps.instruction: Mix 5 µL of the thawed cell suspension with 5 µL of 0.1 % (w/v) Trypan Blue, count viable cells under bright‑field microscopy or with a Countess II instrument, and proceed to cell encapsulation.

steps.title: Load cells onto 10X Chromium chip
steps.instruction: Without washing, follow the Cell Suspension Volume Calculator in the 10X Genomics CG000204 RevD manual to determine loading volume, load the cells directly onto a Chromium microfluidics chip, place the chip into the Chromium instrument, and continue according to the 10X Genomics protocol.

steps.title: Construct library and sequence
steps.instruction: Prepare scRNA‑seq libraries following the 10X Genomics CG000204 RevD manual. Sequence the libraries on a NovaSeq 6000 using paired‑end reads (R1 = 26 cycles, R2 = 70 cycles, index = 8 cycles), aiming for ~150 million reads per ~5 000 cells. Process FASTQ files with the SEQC pipeline using default parameters to generate gene‑cell count matrices.
